text:
About **0.5 hectares of mapped native forest** overlapped with tree-cover loss in 2022—roughly 2.8% of the 17.6-hectare property.

The mapped loss event totaled 0.6 hectares; the remaining 0.1 hectares lay outside the national forest map. A further 0.2 hectares of tree-cover loss occurred in smaller patches, but the evidence does not specify whether those patches were native forest.

Tree-cover loss does not by itself establish deforestation, its cause, or whether it was legal.
